Pedicabs are a great way for folks with mobility impairments to see the city, but it's necessary that all passengers can step into and out of the cab safely and independently. If you have any questions, I'm happy to discuss feasibility and possible accomodations.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Sit back and relax while you enjoy a personalized tour of Boston's best sites from the comfort of a pedicab. See Freedom Trail sites without all the walking. Enjoy bypassing Boston's infamous traffic on a nimble bike taxi with access to bike lanes and trails tour buses can only dream of. 

Tours are led by Rachel, a licensed pedicab driver with 16 years experience and a passionate collector of facts and stories about Boston. 

All tours are private and customizable within the allotted time and service area. Common customization requests include different pick up/drop off points, stops for photos, or adding/omitting certain areas based on interest, and bathroom/snack breaks. Please message me to confirm the feasibility of special requests and itinerary changes. Need a different time? Send me a message. 

Pets small enough to ride in your lap are welcome to join you. 

Tours happen rain or shine and pedicabs are open to the elements. Please dress for the weather.
